body:
The area epic for **the interface** (`interface` in `docs/reviews/areas.json`): the EmulationStation fork, `pixelelated/emulationstation` at the pin `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/ui/emulationstation/package.mk` names (`16dbac5211eea7e70db7394372033be2be7df829`, the tip of `test/qa-integration`, 2026-10-15), read in an EmulationStation worktree with the distribution checkout's rules (D-WORKFLOW-010; plan § 11 item 4), plus the recipe and themes in the distribution (T37). Filed by the coordinator at the area's first dispatch, as plan § 5 says (`docs/reviews/plan-for-the-plan.md`; D-WORKFLOW-189: the definition of work items is the coordinator's). Parent: #339, the renovation epic (D-WORKFLOW-181). The order is `docs/reviews/order.md`, the fourth version (its row is on the P1 branch); the maintainer's call of 2026-10-23 is that slices in different areas run beside each other (D-WORKFLOW-190), so this area's first slice runs beside #695's T1.

**The maintainer's goal, 2026-10-22 (D-WORKFLOW-181, quoted on #339):** *"modernize the codebase; ensure we're adhering to best practices, coding standards, and more; identify bugs; look for where packages may need to be updated; look for where there's room for efficiency in how it works (that's computational, memory management, user experience, etc.); find dead ends; make sure the code itself is clear, well structured, etc.; in general, try to streamline and improve the operating system top to bottom."* This area is what the player sees and presses: the launch path (what a press costs in time to play, D-CLOUD-098), the cloud and achievements pages, the state primitives and the bridge to the OS, and the four hundred-odd upstream files the fork carries. Its first slice is the order's second because the interface's launch path is read before #336 Step 1 replaces what sits under it (D-WORKFLOW-187's reading order).

## The slices, in execution order

| Order | Slice | Issue | Depth | Paths |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T2 | EmulationStation's launch path | #649 | Extended | `es:es-app/src/{FileData,SystemData,LaunchCommand,ProxyCards}.*`, `main.cpp`, `SaveState*`, `views/ViewController.*` (20 paths) |
| T18 | EmulationStation's cloud pages, cards and text, with their unit tests | #665 | Extended | `es-cloud-pages` (30 paths) |
| T20 | EmulationStation's RetroAchievements and offline pages | #667 | Extended | `es-achievements-pages` (25 paths) |
| T21 | EmulationStation's state primitives and its bridge to the OS | #668 | Extended | `es-state-and-bridge` (14 paths) |
| T26 | EmulationStation's main menu (GuiMenu) | #673 | Independent | `es-guimenu` (2 paths) |
| T31 | EmulationStation's other pages | #678 | Independent | `es-pages` (76 paths) |
| T32 | EmulationStation's game list views, scrapers and services | #679 | Independent | `es-app-views-scrapers` (42 paths) |
| T33 | EmulationStation's system layer: ApiSystem, game lists, collections, metadata | #680 | Independent | `es-app-system` (77 paths) |
| T34 | EmulationStation's core components | #681 | Independent | `es-core-components` (80 paths) |
| T35 | EmulationStation's window, input, settings and the rest of es-core | #682 | Independent | `es-core-window-input` (96 paths) |
| T36 | EmulationStation's utilities, resources and renderers | #683 | Independent | `es-core-utils-resources` (58 paths) |
| T37 | the EmulationStation recipe and themes in the distribution | #684 | Independent | `es-recipe` (15 paths) |
| T44 | EmulationStation's vendored libraries, translations and build files | #691 | Local | `es-vendored-and-data` (594 paths) |

The exact membership of each is `tools/renovation-inventory --order` on the P1 tip (`2174265e9c`); the id in the Paths column is the slice's id in `docs/reviews/slices.json`. Each slice runs under plan § 6b from the brief the coordinator writes before its dispatch (`docs/reviews/briefs/<slice>.md`); each child is re-parented under this epic and retitled `M6.P2 E<this>/T<k>` at its dispatch. The futro for this epic is run by the coordinator before T2's first audit commit and posted here. Two things every slice of this area shares: an EmulationStation worktree of its own at the pin (`/home/max/Development/emulationstation-next.worktrees/m6-<slice>-<issue>`, branch `feature/m6-<slice>-<issue>` from the pin; the primary ES checkout is somebody else's branch and is never checked out), and a `fixed-at-es:` line beside `fixed-at:` at hand-back, because the fixes land in the ES repository and reach the distribution as a pin bump the coordinator makes at integration (`docs/reviews/README.md`, the drift tool's `es=` hash).

Can this be done on the VM? Yes for every behaviour claim: the GENERIC_X64 image runs the same EmulationStation binary and 640x480 panel as a handheld (`vm-first.md`); reading, the unit tests (`es-app/tests/unit`, doctest, built with the toolchain's cmake on the host) and the syntax-only compile need no guest. Nothing in this epic builds an image: a fix is proven on the guest at the first image that carries it, which is the coordinator's integration build, and until then by the unit tests, the syntax check and the walk written for that image.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `docs/futros/<date>-m6-interface.md` exists and the same text is a comment on this issue, its adding commit dated before T2's first audit commit (`git log --format=%cI --diff-filter=A -- <each>`).
- [ ] Each of the thirteen slice issues above is closed completed with `reviewed-at:`, `fixed-at:` and, where an ES path changed, `fixed-at-es:` set in its body, and `docs/reviews/status.md` lists the thirteen slices as `closed`.
- [ ] `tools/renovation-drift` reports no closed slice of this area with an unreviewed change at the time the last of the thirteen closes (its output pasted here).
- [ ] Each slice's audit folder `docs/audits/<date>-epic-m6-<slice>/` passes `tools/lint-audit-artifacts` with the renovation face, and each slice's retro exists under `docs/retros/`.
- [ ] The pin in `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/ui/emulationstation/package.mk` on `next` names a commit that carries every slice's fixes, and `tools/es-menu-map-check` passes at that pin.

## Later dependency provenance and currency work

[#1414](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/issues/1414) is an M6 backlog child of this epic for T44's five named vendor provenance/currency follow-ups. It records temporary retention of doctest 2.4.12 while a separately pinned compatibility evaluation is scheduled, and preserves inherited T20 R13 and the other library-owner boundaries. It is outside the thirteen-slice execution order; creation does not dispatch source updates or change T46's position. The coordinator schedules it at its documented revisit trigger.
